verdict.rationale: Auth0's docs describe federating an existing enterprise directory so employees can sign in with their enterprise credentials. They also list enterprise SSO as a login method, AD/LDAP integration and Google Workspace directory sync, and the pricing page includes an Enterprise Connection. However, the evidence never explicitly documents SAML or OIDC enterprise IdP connections, or Okta and Entra as identity providers; the only SAML mention concerns authenticating a web app. missing for 10: explicit SAML/OIDC enterprise connection docs, named Okta/Entra/Google Workspace IdP setup, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in
